evals.name: add-redis-to-usecase
evals.prompt: In this repo, extend the ephemeral use case k8s/overlays/usecases/db-migration-a-to-b so the migrate Job can use Redis as a progress checkpoint store. Add the catalog Redis component to the use case, expose it in the use case contract as an endpoint named 'checkpoint', size it for a laptop, and make sure the overlay still builds and the contract still validates. Do not modify the existing Job manifests at all; wiring the checkpoint into the migrate Job is a later task.
evals.expected_output: Redis component wired into namespaces/uc-db-migration-a-to-b/kustomization.yaml, listed in usecase.yaml spec.components and spec.outputs.endpoints, a resources patch, overlay builds, validate-usecases invariants hold.

assertions.text: redis component referenced from the namespace sub-overlay
every component in the contract exists in the catalog
a Redis resources patch is registered (laptop sizing)

evals.name: component-list-to-crawl-overlay
evals.prompt: Create a new ephemeral use case named doc-qa under k8s/overlays/usecases/ for a Crawl-stage PoC: documents are parsed with Docling, embeddings stored in LanceDB, and Ollama serves the model. Use the catalog components, follow the use-case convention (contract, suspended seed/verify Jobs, .env.example for any secret, laptop sizing), set ttl 2h, isolation shared, Job prefix docqa. The seed Job can just create a bucket/table placeholder and the verify Job can check the three services answer; keep them minimal but real.
evals.expected_output: A buildable k8s/overlays/usecases/doc-qa with usecase.yaml naming docqa-seed and docqa-validate, three catalog components, endpoints for docling, lancedb and ollama.

assertions.text: verify Job named docqa-validate or docqa-verify (the scaffolder's default)
every component in the contract exists in the catalog

assertions.cmd: kubectl kustomize --enable-helm k8s/overlays/usecases/doc-qa | yq ea '[select(.kind == "Job" and (.metadata.name | test("docqa-seed")))] | .[0].spec.suspend' | grep -qx true
kubectl kustomize --enable-helm k8s/overlays/usecases/doc-qa | yq ea '[select(.kind == "Job" and (.metadata.name | test("docqa-(validate|verify)")))] | .[0].spec.suspend' | grep -qx true

evals.name: pack-constrained-stage-overlay
evals.prompt: The use case k8s/overlays/usecases/db-migration-a-to-b has context packs declared in plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/tests/fixtures/db-migration-a-to-b/.builder/packs.yaml (copy that .builder directory into the use case first). Add a Walk stage overlay at stages/walk/ that extends the Crawl overlay with Sealed Secrets and ArgoCD from the catalog and labels the namespace for the Pod Security Admission level the active packs require for Walk. Make sure the stage overlay builds on its own.
evals.expected_output: stages/walk/kustomization.yaml referencing ../.. plus sealed-secrets and argocd components, a Namespace patch with pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (required by regulated-corp SEC-1), builds.

assertions.text: recomposes the Crawl overlay from its parts (kustomize refuses ../.. as a cycle)
stage overlay builds on its own
PSA restricted required by pack SEC-1 is applied

evals.name: assemble-invoice-intake
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/records/invoice-intake/ into decisions/, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/gates/invoice-intake.yaml to gates.yaml, and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/scaffold/invoice-intake.yaml to scaffold.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else), and write packs.yaml there activating context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp). The app/ directory under the use case already exists. Then assemble the complete overlay of the use case invoice-intake from those records: the Crawl root under k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/ with its namespace sub-overlay, the catalog components the records chose, the scaffold's Jobs and Deployments, secrets with their .env.example recipes, usecase.yaml, and the stages/walk and stages/run overlays with everything the security and devops records demand from Walk (PSA labels, default-deny NetworkPolicies and the egress allow-list, sealed secrets replacing every generated Secret, the ArgoCD Application on a tag). The root and every stage must build with kustomize and pass kubeconform.
evals.expected_output: assemble.py run and reviewed: root, walk and run build and pass kubeconform; default-deny, PSA restricted, sealed placeholders with recipes, the Application; usecase.yaml with spec.build; secret-scan clean; every ci gate of crawl->walk passes.

assertions.text: every component in the contract exists
the verify Job is the quality record's inv-validate
Walk stage builds on its own
Run stage builds on its own

assertions.cmd: kubectl kustomize --enable-helm k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/stages/walk | yq ea '[select(.kind == "NetworkPolicy" and .metadata.name == "default-deny" and .metadata.namespace == "uc-invoice-intake")] | length' | grep -qx 1
assertions.text: default-deny NetworkPolicy in the Walk build

assertions.cmd: kubectl kustomize --enable-helm k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/stages/walk | yq ea '[select(.kind == "Namespace" and .metadata.name == "uc-invoice-intake")] | .[0].metadata.labels["pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce"]' | grep -qx restricted
assertions.text: PSA restricted enforced at Walk (security record, pack SEC-1)

assertions.cmd: kubectl kustomize --enable-helm k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/stages/walk | yq ea '[select(.kind == "Secret" and .metadata.namespace == "uc-invoice-intake" and ((.data // {}) | length > 0 or (.stringData // {}) | length > 0))] | length' | grep -qx 0
assertions.text: no plain Secret rendered at Walk: every generated one is deleted and sealed

assertions.cmd: kubectl kustomize --enable-helm k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/stages/walk | yq ea '[select(.kind == "SealedSecret")] | length' | awk '$1 >= 3'
assertions.text: SealedSecrets replace the generated Secrets at Walk

assertions.cmd: kubectl kustomize --enable-helm k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/stages/walk | yq ea '[select(.kind == "Application")] | .[0].spec.syncPolicy.automated.selfHeal' | grep -qx true
assertions.text: ArgoCD Application with selfHeal at Walk
.env.example recipes with the seal command for every Crawl secret
secret-scan clean over the assembled use case

assertions.cmd: cd . && python3 scripts/gates/gates.py run invoice-intake --transition crawl-walk --only ci --usecase-dir k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake | grep -q 'fail: 0'
assertions.text: every ci gate of crawl->walk passes on what was written
README carries the decision summary, open questions and gates
